facts.fact: Okolo and Raji (published 2026-01-23) describe Kenya's Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Society Bill, 2023 as a bill that would set licensing requirements on five principles and has drawn criticism for a narrow approach and weak enforcement; the document gives no later date for its status, so the date is the bill's year.
